## Graduate Teaching Assistant, Experiential Learning

### Commodity Investing by Students (COINS) Analyst Training Course
**Fall 2024 -- Spring 2026** | Virginia Tech  
*Listed as AAEC 4504: Agricultural Price and Market Analysis*

A year-spanning experiential learning course in which student analysts research
commodity markets and manage a fund investing \$1.3+ million of the
university's endowment. I train analysts in commodity research, market analysis,
and portfolio decision-making.
